messages.content: The Philadelphia-to-Newark flights are ticketed now. Please compare the split conference stay against using one Philadelphia hotel for all three nights, then look at the two Newark choices for Wednesday.

The split is $763.46 total: Windsor Suites on Sunday for $246.62, then the Logan conference block Monday and Tuesday for $516.84. Staying at Windsor all three Philadelphia nights is $930.57. The split saves $167.11 but requires a Monday hotel change.
How inconvenient is that change? Also, the conference hotel being unavailable Wednesday does not matter if moving to Newark that afternoon is still the sensible plan.

Windsor and the Logan are 0.6 miles apart. It is about a 12-minute walk, or typically 6 to 12 minutes by car. Windsor will hold your bag after checkout, and the Logan accepts luggage before check-in. You could transfer before the first session with roughly 25 minutes of total effort. Moving to Newark Wednesday remains necessary for the Thursday meeting and flight.
That is manageable. What are the Newark tradeoffs, including the actual Thursday timing?

Courtyard Newark Downtown is $218.36 and 12 to 18 minutes from the supplier site. After the noon meeting, it is about 18 to 28 minutes from the hotel to EWR, but there is no shuttle. Renaissance Newark Airport is $231.74 with a complimentary airport shuttle; its Thursday morning drive to the supplier is usually 28 to 40 minutes. Both leave ample time for your 5:05 p.m. departure.

Google currently shows 4.1 for the Courtyard and 3.9 for the Renaissance. Their customer-review scores are 8.2 and 8.0, respectively, on the booking platform. Those are separate metrics from hotel class.

For work travel where the hotel is only serving the schedule, do not apply my 4.0 cutoff unless I specifically describe the stay as nice or upscale. Keep that cutoff confined to those kinds of searches. Here, logistics and cancellation terms should decide it.

Understood. For this trip, the Courtyard has the easier morning and costs $13.38 less. The Renaissance makes the airport handoff simpler, but adds roughly 15 to 22 minutes before the meeting and still requires returning for stored luggage after the meeting.
Please verify cancellation for the whole combination before booking anything.

Windsor Sunday is refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time the day before arrival; later cancellation costs one night. The Logan conference booking is refundable until 72 hours before check-in, then one night is charged. The Courtyard is refundable until 11:59 p.m. local time two days before arrival, with a one-night penalty afterward.
The three-night Windsor rate is refundable until 6:00 p.m. two days before arrival. After that, the first night is charged. It remains $167.11 more than the split arrangement.
Use the split Philadelphia plan and the Courtyard in Newark. Book all three reservations with the traveler and payment details on file.

Booked. Windsor Suites is confirmed for Sunday under WSP-684219; the Logan conference stay for Monday and Tuesday is LPH-391746; and Courtyard Newark Downtown for Wednesday is CND-805133. The combined lodging total is $981.82. The cancellation deadlines and penalties are unchanged, and the Wednesday move to Newark remains timed after the conference program.
